description: Leak-free split of Defog_Dataset. Scenes 00-09 are one continuous recording; test keeps 03 and 09 (as in the shipped EDFog), val takes the start of the chain (00, 01) plus the independent GoPro recording GH019005. GH019007/08/09 are consecutive GoPro recordings and stay together in train. leakfree_split.py removes a buffer from the train side at every continuous train|eval boundary (01|02, 02|03, 03|04, 08|09).
